subject: We can use your help to make Stan even more awesome

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: We can use your help to make Stan even more awesome
parts:
Dear Stan users:

We have developed Stan using partial support from several different research grants involving statistical modeling, computation, and applications. Continued development of Stan will be facilitated by continued outside funding.

Here's a way that some of you can help: If you are putting together a grant proposal for a project in which you would be, or would like to be, using Stan, you could write us into your grant. Support for a postdoc or programmer can help us with general Stan goals (ranging from implementation and optimization of specific model classes, to improvements in areas such as discrete sampling, to new developments in the sampling algorithms and new data structures) and, perhaps more to the point for your grant, we can devote effort to making your particular problem work in Stan.

What we get are the funds to move rapidly forward on our research and development work, thus making Stan both more awesome and more generally useful, both to applied users and to researchers. What you get is an investment in practical and efficient computation for your problem, along with a say in the direction of where Stan goes next..

If this interests you, please contact us directly and we can talk about details!

Yours,
Andrew, Bob, and the rest of the Stan development team
